s:mie/ise-naiku: View from the approach of Uji Bridge at Ise Grand Shrine Naiku: a long arched bridge of plain unpainted cypress with a simple unpainted wooden torii gate at its entrance, crossing the clear Isuzu River, dense ancient cedar forest behind, soft early-morning mist, a few small distant visitors.
s:mie/ise-geku: A wide gravel approach at Ise Grand Shrine Geku leading through towering ancient cedar trees to a plain unpainted cypress torii gate, a simple wooden fence and thatched roofs barely visible beyond, quiet atmosphere, soft dappled morning light, a few small distant visitors.
s:mie/oharai-machi: Eye-level view along the stone-paved Oharai-machi approach street: rows of traditional two-storey wooden shops with dark tiled roofs, deep eaves and plain cypress-wood facades, plain indigo noren curtains hanging at entrances, warm late-afternoon light, small distant strollers.
s:mie/meoto-iwa: Dawn view of Meoto Iwa at Futami: two rocks of different sizes rising from calm sea, joined by a thick braided straw shimenawa rope, a small white torii gate on top of the larger rock, the sun rising between them in a soft orange sky, gentle waves.
s:mie/yokoyama-ago-bay: Elevated morning view from Yokoyama Observatory over Ago Bay: a maze of dozens of small forested islands scattered in a deeply indented, calm blue bay, neat rows of wooden pearl-oyster rafts on the water, light haze, soft early sunlight.
s:mie/iga-ninja: Exterior of a traditional thatched-roof farmhouse at the Iga-ryu Ninja Museum, surrounded by a small garden and bamboo grove, wooden sliding doors partly open to reveal dark interior rooms, soft overcast daylight.
s:mie/nabana-no-sato: Night view inside the Nabana no Sato illumination: a long arched tunnel completely covered with millions of tiny warm golden LED lights, a straight walkway through the centre, small distant visitors silhouetted, glowing reflections on the path.
s:mie/akame-falls: View of one of the Akame waterfalls in autumn: a white cascade falling into a deep emerald-green pool surrounded by moss-covered boulders, red and orange maples overhanging, a wooden walkway along the rocky stream bank, soft diffused light.
f:mie/ise-udon: 45-degree view of Ise udon in a simple ceramic bowl: very thick, soft, pale white noodles coated with a small amount of thick, glossy black-brown sweet soy sauce, topped with chopped green onion, a simple wooden table, soft natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:mie/tekone-zushi: Overhead shot of tekone-zushi in a wooden bowl: glossy, soy-marinated slices of deep red bonito arranged over vinegared rice, sprinkled with shredded shiso leaves, nori strips and sesame seeds, a cup of green tea beside it, wooden table, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:mie/akafuku: Close view of akafuku mochi on a small wooden tray: soft white rice cakes covered with smooth dark red bean paste pressed into three wavy ridges, a cup of roasted bancha tea beside it, a wooden riverside teahouse softly blurred behind, daylight, shallow depth of field.
f:mie/matsusaka-beef: 45-degree view of Matsusaka beef sukiyaki in a shallow iron pan: thin slices of highly marbled beef simmering in a sweet soy broth with tofu, green onion, shiitake and shirataki noodles, a bowl of raw egg beside it, tatami-room table, warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:mie/ise-ebi: Overhead shot of ise-ebi sashimi: a whole spiny lobster with its bright red-orange shell and long antennae arranged on a large ceramic platter, translucent white raw tail meat sliced and placed back on the shell, garnished with shiso and daikon, wooden table, natural light, shallow depth of field.
s:shiga/hikone-castle: View of Hikone Castle in early April: the small three-storey original keep with white plaster walls, bell-shaped windows and gilded ornaments on its many decorative gables, standing on a high stone base atop a wooded hill, framed by full pink cherry blossoms, clear blue sky.
s:shiga/omihachiman: Eye-level view along the Hachiman-bori canal: a narrow green canal lined with old white-walled storehouses and stone steps, a small wooden hand-rowed boat gliding through, willow trees and reeds on the banks, soft spring light.
s:shiga/shirahige-shrine: Dawn view of Shirahige Shrine's vermilion torii gate standing in the shallow water of Lake Biwa, the calm lake surface reflecting a pale orange and pink sky, distant low mountains on the far shore.
s:shiga/enryaku-ji: Temple halls of Enryaku-ji on Mount Hiei: large dark wooden buildings with sweeping grey tiled and copper roofs among towering cedar trees and moss-covered stone lanterns, a few red and orange maples in front, mist drifting through the forest, soft autumn light.
s:shiga/metasequoia-makino: View straight down the centre of the Makino Metasequoia Avenue in late November: a long, straight road flanked by rows of tall conical metasequoia trees in rich rust-orange and copper-brown autumn colour, soft overcast light, no cars.
s:shiga/miho-museum: View from inside the Miho Museum approach tunnel: a curved passage lined with stainless-steel panels glowing softly, opening onto a slender cable-stayed bridge that leads to a glass-and-steel pitched-roof entrance among forested hills, cherry blossoms framing the tunnel mouth, spring daylight.
f:shiga/omi-beef: 45-degree view of Omi beef steak on a teppanyaki iron plate: thick slices of highly marbled beef seared golden-brown on the outside, pink inside, garlic chips, a dab of wasabi and a small dish of salt beside it, warm counter light, shallow depth of field.
f:shiga/funazushi: Close view of thin slices of funazushi fermented crucian carp arranged on a small black ceramic plate, showing pale translucent flesh, a layer of bright orange roe and a little fermented rice, a small sake cup beside it, wooden counter, soft light, shallow depth of field.
f:shiga/baumkuchen: 45-degree view of a slice of baumkuchen on a white plate, showing many thin concentric golden rings with a slightly crisp caramelised outer edge, a cup of coffee beside it, light wooden café table, soft window light, shallow depth of field.
s:kyoto/fushimi-inari: View inside the Senbon Torii at Fushimi Inari Taisha: a long tunnel of closely spaced vermilion torii gates with black bases climbing a stone path up a wooded hillside, sunlight filtering through the gaps and creating stripes of light, a few small distant visitors.
s:kyoto/kiyomizu-dera: Late November view of Kiyomizu-dera's main hall: the huge wooden stage supported by a lattice of tall wooden pillars on a steep slope, surrounded by fiery red and orange maple trees, the city of Kyoto hazy in the background, soft afternoon light.
s:kyoto/gion-hanamikoji: Evening view along the stone-paved Hanamikoji Street in Gion: traditional two-storey wooden teahouses with dark lattice fronts, bamboo screens and red lanterns glowing softly, wet paving stones reflecting warm light, a few small distant figures.
s:kyoto/arashiyama: View down the narrow path of the Arashiyama bamboo grove: towering green bamboo stalks rising on both sides, light filtering through the canopy above, a low wooden fence edging the gravel path, soft green light.
s:kyoto/kinkaku-ji: View across the Kyoko-chi Pond of Kinkaku-ji: the three-storey pavilion with its upper two storeys covered in gleaming gold leaf, a natural-wood ground floor and a bronze phoenix on the shingled roof, mirrored in the still water among pines and small rocky islets, clear blue autumn sky.
s:kyoto/ginkaku-ji: View of Ginkaku-ji: the two-storey wooden Kannon-den with dark weathered timber and a bronze phoenix on its roof, set behind the Ginshadan, a raked white sand garden with a flat-topped sand cone, moss and pines around, soft afternoon light.
s:kyoto/tofuku-ji: Late November view from Tofuku-ji of the wooden Tsutenkyo covered bridge spanning a deep ravine filled with brilliant red, orange and yellow maple trees, temple roofs visible beyond, soft overcast light.
s:kyoto/byodoin-uji: View across the pond of Byodo-in's Phoenix Hall: a vermilion wooden hall with symmetrical wing corridors and sweeping grey tiled roofs, two golden phoenix statues on the central ridge, reflected in calm water, clear morning light.
s:kyoto/kurama-kibune: Stone-stepped approach at Kibune Shrine lined with rows of red wooden lanterns on both sides, climbing up through tall cedar trees and red autumn maples, soft diffused light filtering through the trees, a few small distant visitors.
s:kyoto/amanohashidate-ine: Elevated view from a hillside observation deck of Amanohashidate: a long, narrow sandbar covered with thousands of green pine trees stretching across a calm blue bay, connecting two shores, clear sunny day with white clouds.
f:kyoto/yudofu: 45-degree view of yudofu: soft white cubes of tofu simmering gently in clear kombu broth in a ceramic pot over a small burner, a cup of soy dipping sauce, chopped green onion and grated ginger beside it, tatami room with a garden view softly blurred, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:kyoto/nishin-soba: 45-degree view of nishin soba: hot buckwheat noodles in a clear light brown dashi broth, topped with a whole glossy dark brown sweet-simmered herring fillet and chopped green onion, a simple ceramic bowl, wooden counter, warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:kyoto/obanzai: Overhead shot of a selection of obanzai side dishes in small ceramic bowls: simmered pumpkin, stewed daikon, boiled spinach with sesame, tofu skin and pickled vegetables, arranged on a wooden counter, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:kyoto/uji-matcha: 45-degree view of a tall glass of matcha parfait: layers of matcha ice cream, sweet red bean paste, white mochi balls, matcha jelly and cream, topped with a dusting of matcha powder, a wooden café table, soft window light, shallow depth of field.
f:kyoto/saba-zushi: Overhead shot of saba-zushi: a long bar of pressed sushi sliced into thick pieces, showing a layer of silvery marinated mackerel on top of vinegared rice, wrapped in a strip of translucent kelp, arranged on a bamboo leaf on a wooden board, natural light, shallow depth of field.
s:osaka/dotonbori: Night view from Ebisu Bridge along the Dotonbori Canal: building facades stacked with huge, colourful neon and LED light displays, all reflected in the dark rippling water, a small canal cruise boat passing, crowds of small distant people on the riverside walkways.
s:osaka/kuromon-market: Inside the covered arcade of Kuromon Market: stalls displaying fresh seafood on crushed ice, scallops and skewers sizzling on hot grills, neat piles of bright fruit under warm lights, small distant shoppers walking through the long aisle.
s:osaka/osaka-castle: View of Osaka Castle's main keep in early April: a five-tiered tower with white walls, green copper-tiled roofs and gilded tiger and fish ornaments on its gables, standing on massive dressed-stone walls above a wide moat, framed by full pink cherry blossoms, clear blue sky.
s:osaka/shinsekai: Evening view along the main street of Shinsekai: retro shopfronts and kushikatsu restaurants decorated with bright coloured lights, paper lanterns and oversized three-dimensional food decorations, the steel Tsutenkaku Tower lit up at the end of the street, small distant people walking.
s:osaka/umeda-sky: Night view from below of the Umeda Sky Building: two tall glass-and-steel towers joined at the top by a large ring-shaped open-air observation deck and bridging floors, illuminated against a deep blue evening sky, Osaka city lights around.
s:osaka/usj: Daytime view across the central lagoon of a large theme park in Osaka: colourful buildings in early 20th-century American city styles along the waterfront, palm trees, a steel roller coaster track arching in the distance, small distant crowds on the promenade, sunny blue sky.
s:osaka/kaiyukan: View inside Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan: a massive deep-blue tank with a whale shark gliding through, surrounded by schools of fish and rays, light filtering from above, a few small distant visitors silhouetted against the glass.
s:osaka/sumiyoshi-taisha: View of Sumiyoshi Taisha's Sorihashi bridge: a steeply arched vermilion wooden bridge spanning a calm pond, reflected in the water, surrounded by trees, a vermilion shrine gate visible behind, clear sunny day.
s:osaka/expo-park: View of the Tower of the Sun at Expo '70 Commemorative Park: a tall white sculpture with outstretched arms marked by red zigzag stripes, a golden face at the top and a grey face on its belly, standing on a wide green lawn among cherry trees in bloom, clear spring sky.
s:osaka/minoh-falls: Late November view of Minoh Falls: a white waterfall plunging about 33 metres down a dark rock face into a pool, framed by red, orange and yellow maple trees, a stone path in the foreground, soft overcast light.
f:osaka/takoyaki: 45-degree view of takoyaki: six golden-brown balls in a paper boat tray, topped with sweet brown sauce, white mayonnaise zigzags, green aonori powder and dancing bonito flakes, wooden toothpicks inserted, street stall background softly blurred, warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:osaka/okonomiyaki: 45-degree view of okonomiyaki on a hot iron griddle: a thick round savory pancake with shredded cabbage, coated with sweet brown sauce, white mayonnaise lattice, green aonori powder and bonito flakes, a small metal spatula beside it, warm restaurant light, shallow depth of field.
f:osaka/kushikatsu: Close view of several kushikatsu skewers: meat, seafood and vegetables coated in fine golden breadcrumbs and deep-fried, arranged on a metal tray, a shared container of dark brown dipping sauce and a plate of raw cabbage leaves beside it, warm counter light, shallow depth of field.
f:osaka/kitsune-udon: 45-degree view of kitsune udon: thick white noodles in a clear light golden dashi broth, topped with a large sweet glossy fried tofu pouch and chopped green onion, a simple ceramic bowl, wooden table, warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:osaka/butaman: Close view of several steamed pork buns: soft, fluffy white buns with a slightly wrinkled top, one torn open to reveal a juicy pork and onion filling, arranged in a bamboo steamer, steam rising, wooden counter, warm light, shallow depth of field.
s:hyogo/himeji-castle: View of Himeji Castle in early April: the brilliant white multi-tiered main keep with layered gabled roofs and white plaster walls, standing on high stone walls, framed by full pink cherry blossoms, clear blue sky.
s:hyogo/kitano-ijinkan: View of a Western-style red brick house with a pointed roof, wooden balconies and white-framed windows on a sloping street in Kitano Ijinkan, surrounded by trees and flower pots, clear blue sky, soft daylight.
s:hyogo/kobe-harborland: Dusk view of Kobe Port from Meriken Park: the red lattice Kobe Port Tower, the white net-like Kobe Maritime Museum, and a large Ferris wheel in Harborland across the water, all lit up and reflected in the calm harbour, pink and blue sky.
s:hyogo/mount-maya: Night view from Kikuseidai on Mt. Maya: a vast panorama of glittering city lights stretching along the curving coastline of Kobe and Osaka Bay, dark mountains in the foreground, clear night sky.
s:hyogo/arima-onsen: View along a narrow sloping lane in Arima Onsen: old two-storey wooden shops and inns with dark tiled roofs on both sides, and beside the lane a hot spring source enclosure with steam rising and rust-orange iron mineral deposits crusted on the stones, soft afternoon light, small distant figures.
s:hyogo/kinosaki-onsen: Evening view along the willow-lined canal in Kinosaki Onsen: traditional wooden ryokan and shops with warm lights, stone bridges crossing the calm water, willow branches hanging over, small distant figures in yukata walking, soft blue hour light.
s:hyogo/takeda-castle: Early-morning view of Takeda Castle Ruins: ancient stone walls on a mountaintop rising above a vast sea of white clouds filling the valley, distant mountain ridges, soft golden autumn sunrise light.
s:hyogo/awaji-island: View of the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge: a long white suspension bridge spanning a blue strait, with tall towers and cables, Awaji Island's green hills in the distance, a field of colourful flowers in the foreground, clear sunny day.
f:hyogo/kobe-beef: 45-degree view of Kobe beef on a teppanyaki grill: thick slices of highly marbled beef seared golden-brown, garlic chips and grilled vegetables beside it, a chef's metal spatula, warm counter light, shallow depth of field.
f:hyogo/akashiyaki: 45-degree view of akashiyaki: soft golden-yellow eggy dumplings arranged on a tilted wooden board, a bowl of clear light dashi broth for dipping beside it, chopped green onion, wooden table, warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:hyogo/matsuba-crab: Overhead shot of a matsuba crab hot pot: bright red crab legs and shell pieces simmering in a clear broth with napa cabbage, tofu, shiitake mushrooms and green onion in a ceramic pot, a dish of ponzu sauce beside it, tatami room, warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:hyogo/nankinmachi: Close view of several steamed pork buns and xiaolongbao dumplings in a bamboo steamer on a street-food stall counter in Nankinmachi, steam rising, red lanterns softly blurred in the background, warm light, shallow depth of field.
s:nara/todai-ji: View of Todai-ji's Daibutsuden: a massive wooden hall with a sweeping dark tiled roof and golden ornaments at the ridge ends, standing behind a wide stone-paved courtyard and a large bronze lantern, clear blue sky, a few small distant visitors.
s:nara/nara-park: View of Nara Park in autumn: several sika deer with brown coats and white-spotted backs grazing on a green lawn under trees with red and orange leaves, a temple roof visible in the background, soft sunlight.
s:nara/kasuga-taisha: View of Kasuga Taisha's stone-lantern-lined approach: rows of moss-covered stone lanterns along a path through a dense green forest, a vermilion shrine building visible at the end, soft dappled light.
s:nara/naramachi: Eye-level view along a narrow lane in Naramachi: traditional two-storey wooden machiya townhouses with dark lattice windows, white walls and tiled roofs, potted plants by the doors, soft afternoon light.
s:nara/horyu-ji: View of Horyu-ji's five-storey pagoda and main hall: ancient wooden buildings with weathered timber, white plaster walls and dark tiled roofs, standing in a gravel courtyard surrounded by a roofed corridor, clear blue sky.
s:nara/yoshino: View of Mt. Yoshino in early April: forested mountain slopes covered with thousands of pale pink wild cherry trees in full bloom, a temple roof visible among them, soft hazy spring light.
s:nara/asuka: Early autumn view of Ishibutai Kofun in Asuka: the exposed stone burial chamber made of giant granite boulders, its earth mound long gone, sitting in a grassy park, with golden rice fields, red spider lilies along the paths and low green hills beyond, clear blue sky.
f:nara/kakinoha-zushi: Overhead shot of kakinoha-zushi: small rectangular pieces of pressed sushi wrapped in green persimmon leaves, a few unwrapped to show slices of mackerel or salmon on vinegared rice, arranged in a wooden box, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:nara/miwa-somen: 45-degree view of chilled miwa somen: very thin white noodles in a glass bowl of iced water, a cup of dipping sauce, chopped green onion and grated ginger beside it, a light wooden table, natural summer light, shallow depth of field.
f:nara/kuzumochi: Close view of translucent kuzumochi: soft, glossy jelly-like pieces on a small ceramic plate, drizzled with dark brown kuromitsu syrup and sprinkled with golden roasted soybean flour, a cup of green tea beside it, wooden table, natural light, shallow depth of field.
s:wakayama/koyasan-okunoin: View along the Okunoin cemetery path at Koyasan: a stone-paved trail winding through towering ancient cedar trees, lined with countless moss-covered stone gravestones and pagodas, mist drifting through the forest, soft diffused light.
s:wakayama/kongobu-ji: View of the Konpon Daito at Danjo Garan on Koyasan: a huge vermilion two-tiered pagoda with a rounded white middle section, broad dark roofs and a bronze spire, standing on a gravel precinct among tall cedar trees, a few red autumn maples nearby, clear blue sky.
s:wakayama/kumano-kodo: View along the Kumano Kodo trail: a narrow stone-paved path winding through a dense forest of tall cedar trees, moss-covered roots and rocks, a small wooden shrine marker by the path, soft green light filtering through the canopy.
s:wakayama/kumano-hongu: View of the giant torii gate at Oyunohara near Kumano Hongu Taisha: a massive dark grey steel torii about 34 metres tall standing among green rice fields, surrounded by forested mountains with low mist, soft early summer morning light.
s:wakayama/nachi-falls: View of Nachi Falls with Seiganto-ji's three-storey pagoda: a vermilion three-storey pagoda in the foreground, a white waterfall plunging 133 metres down a dark cliff in the background, surrounded by lush green forest, soft morning light.
s:wakayama/shirarahama: View of Shirarahama beach: a wide crescent of fine white sand, clear turquoise sea water, gentle waves, hotels lining the shore, green hills in the background, bright summer sunlight.
s:wakayama/wakayama-castle: View of Wakayama Castle in early April: a white three-storey castle keep with dark tiled roofs on a stone wall, standing on a hill, framed by full pink cherry blossoms, clear blue sky.
f:wakayama/wakayama-ramen: 45-degree view of Wakayama ramen: thin straight noodles in a rich brown pork bone and soy broth, topped with slices of pork chashu, bamboo shoots, chopped green onion and kamaboko fish cake, a plate of mackerel pressed sushi beside it, wooden counter, warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:wakayama/shojin-ryori: Overhead shot of a shojin ryori meal on lacquered trays: sesame tofu with wasabi, simmered koya tofu, tempura of seasonal vegetables, pickles, rice and miso soup in small bowls, tatami room, soft natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:wakayama/katsuura-tuna: 45-degree view of a fresh tuna donburi: thick slices of glossy deep-red raw tuna arranged over vinegared rice in a ceramic bowl, garnished with shiso leaf and wasabi, a small dish of soy sauce beside it, wooden table, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:wakayama/nanko-ume: Close view of several plump, wrinkled red umeboshi pickled plums on a small white ceramic dish, glistening with moisture, a small glass of amber umeshu plum wine beside it, wooden table, natural light, shallow depth of field.
